title: Send a voice message on WhatsApp
aliases: how do i send a voice message on whatsapp
talk instead of typing in whatsapp
send an audio message on whatsapp
leave a spoken message on whatsapp

steps.instruction: Tap the chat with the person you want to message.
Slide your finger up from the microphone icon to the padlock to keep recording without holding it.
Say your message while the recording timer is moving.
Tap the paper plane icon to send your voice message.

source_note: WhatsApp for iPhone, October 2026 layout on iOS 26/27, English. Assumes an existing individual chat, an empty message box and microphone access already allowed. Uses locked recording so the user need not hold a button between coach steps. The current iPhone recording article could not be retrieved; confirm the upward gesture, timer and send control on the installed version. Not checked on a phone.
